title: Inf jump and noclip gui mobile support
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- SETTINGS
local infiniteJumpEnabled = false
local noClipEnabled = false

-- CREATE GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "MobileMovementControls"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- MAIN FRAME
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 135)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -215, 0.5, -70)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local frameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
frameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
frameCorner.Parent = mainFrame

-- TITLE / DRAG BAR
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Name = "DragBar"
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
title.Text = "MOBILE CONTROLS"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.TextScaled = true
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.BorderSizePixel = 0
title.Active = true
title.Parent = mainFrame

local titleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
titleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
titleCorner.Parent = title

-- BUTTON CREATOR
local function createButton(name, text, position)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name = name
	button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 42)
	button.Position = position
	button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55)
	button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	button.Text = text .. " [OFF]"
	button.TextScaled = true
	button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	button.AutoButtonColor = true
	button.Active = true
	button.Parent = mainFrame

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	corner.Parent = button

	return button
end

local infiniteJumpButton = createButton(
	"InfiniteJumpButton",
	"INFINITE JUMP",
	UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 42)
)

local noClipButton = createButton(
	"NoClipButton",
	"NO CLIP",
	UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 88)
)

-- DRAGGING
local dragging = false
local dragStart = nil
local startingPosition = nil

title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startingPosition = mainFrame.Position
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not dragging then
		return
	end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then

		local difference = input.Position - dragStart

		mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
			startingPosition.X.Scale,
			startingPosition.X.Offset + difference.X,
			startingPosition.Y.Scale,
			startingPosition.Y.Offset + difference.Y
		)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

		dragging = false
	end
end)

-- INFINITE JUMP
infiniteJumpButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	infiniteJumpEnabled = not infiniteJumpEnabled

	if infiniteJumpEnabled then
		infiniteJumpButton.Text = "INFINITE JUMP [ON]"
		infiniteJumpButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 170, 70)
	else
		infiniteJumpButton.Text = "INFINITE JUMP [OFF]"
		infiniteJumpButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55)
	end
end)

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
	if not infiniteJumpEnabled then
		return
	end

	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
	end
end)

-- NO CLIP
local savedCollisionStates = {}

local function saveCollisionStates(character)
	savedCollisionStates = {}

	for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			savedCollisionStates[object] = object.CanCollide
		end
	end
end

local function restoreCollisionStates()
	for object, collisionState in pairs(savedCollisionStates) do
		if object and object.Parent then
			object.CanCollide = collisionState
		end
	end

	savedCollisionStates = {}
end

noClipButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	noClipEnabled = not noClipEnabled

	local character = player.Character

	if noClipEnabled then
		noClipButton.Text = "NO CLIP [ON]"
		noClipButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 170, 70)

		if character then
			saveCollisionStates(character)
		end
	else
		noClipButton.Text = "NO CLIP [OFF]"
		noClipButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55)

		restoreCollisionStates()
	end
end)

-- NO CLIP LOOP
RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
	if not noClipEnabled then
		return
	end

	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end

	for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			object.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
end)

-- RESPAWN SUPPORT
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	savedCollisionStates = {}

	if noClipEnabled then
		task.wait(0.5)
		saveCollisionStates(character)
	end
end)
